title: Build Grave Accord and polish multiplayer and first-run reliability
head: feat/first-playable-loop
body:
Grave Accord now has a cooperative boss-fight loop with seven classes, 378 skills, 28 weapons, 66 boss identities, six maps and five modes. Offline Solo, public/private waiting rooms, host-only Start, optional passwords, profiles, encounter-boundary saves and authority-written team records are implemented. First-time players get a prepared Start gently option, an optional Tutorial, plain setup labels, named shop items and separate health/shield/resource displays. Public and testing share the presentation; testing retains rehearsal tools.

Local-network setup could lose a typed address, let an old response replace a newer Host result, redraw a page after leaving, or leave Stop hosting disabled after a failure. The page now owns cleanup and delayed responses, preserves drafts and cursor position, restores retries and blocks conflicting actions while keeping Back available. Six compiled menu regressions fail on the earlier code and pass here, including the actual setup lifecycle. The manual home gallery shows the existing full cover, seven survivors and six map paintings with arrows, page buttons, keyboard/RTL labels and remembered selection.

The fixed camera keeps full boss/survivor art visible while upper passages remain usable, and actual cursor events share its transform. Brass Toad follows connected clear hops around cover on all 36 map/difficulty combinations. Painted lava retains its timing/damage with the extra ring removed. Boss clears hold their position/floor for five seconds with a sound and preparation message; 15 bosses have full falls and 51 have final poses. Online menus/chat remain personal; the current host explicitly pauses/continues, departure resumes play and transfers controls, and End game for everyone is separately confirmed. Password reveal stays private to the host Session. Chat waits for server confirmation and preserves failed drafts. Difficulty-based Medic recovery and combined/start shield limits remain finite; future cover art, bots/story and class expansion stay deferred.

This remains development work. Human multiplayer/balance, rendered/device/listening/native-language, complete action art, physical second-computer LAN, WAN/endurance/capacity and shared hosted rankings/recovery acceptance remain open. Browser automation is disabled. Protected main and the older protocol 4 Site/protocol 13 published Windows release remain separate. This draft does not deploy the game, merge main, replace a hosted release or submit the contest.
